items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: I imagine I played with John about two or three years, not longer than that.

ctx.x: I mean, you played quite a long while with John Marrera, for instance. I mean...

Not too long. I imagine I played with John about two or three years, not longer than that. Because after that, Paul left town, I think, and John left town, and then there was a large... He created a large band. And then I stopped playing in 35 for 18 years. I didn't play with them anymore. I stopped in order to rear my family, because I married in 29. See, I joined in 26, I married in 29, and then I reared my family. After that, I stayed home to rear my family. I quit in 35. But during that time, I was still…

When you were playing with those early bands, like, say, the Celestine band with John Marrera, what did the banjo and the piano play together? I mean, did you both play the same chords all the while, or did you play on any different beats?
